title: Smiling Young Man on Memorial Steps, 1950s Washington DC B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Big Jim -
After eating Rice Krispies 3 times a day for 397 days I can now pick on the bullies - if they're under 90 pounds -
an unsolicited report.
and how do ya spell it?
B 557
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot capturing a young man striking a playful muscle pose on the massive steps leading up to a grand neoclassical monument, likely the Lincoln Memorial in Washington, D.C. He wears a short-sleeved button-up shirt, light trousers, and loafers with white socks. In the background, large marble columns and other visitors are visible. The back contains a witty, handwritten note addressed to 'Big Jim' joking about eating Rice Krispies to fight bullies.
